acceptanceCriteria: Exact path, normalized/casefold identity and hardlink aliases refuse without modifying OCM bytes.

body: Confirmed by independent review of unreleased candidate da02db8c7cc80618978bed565cd9dac62c7ad1f5. read.go only guards CEM map output identity; `cem report --ocm x --output x` or hardlink alias can overwrite supplied OCM bytes. Expected: reject before publication and preserve exact evidence bytes. Root repair in V1-0501; regression evidence pending bounded repair. Not an installed rc.1 defect claim.
title: Proof report: Markdown output alias can overwrite supplied OCM evidence
